intervention: reader_only: reopen the same complete immutable base and saved candidate bundles from each original repeat; do not refit controls, regenerate patches, change masks, cameras, sampling or scales.
paired_policy: Sixty fresh fixed-consensus robust-axis readouts individually paired with all sixty frozen metric readouts. Each new readout repeat runs in a fresh subprocess. Native added-curve geometry must be byte-value identical to the paired normal record and is separately rescored without readout clipping.
qualification: Previously seen local fixture development evidence for a predeclared robust-axis task only. No general rod/plane/parallel-member/topology discrimination, independent object or G1 qualification. Within-voxel sampling can change representative means. Empty, unresolved, noisy and gap errors remain in the complete table.
